nations.name: Ho-Chunk Nation
nations.lands: Wisconsin, United States, on lands in many places rather than one reservation; traditional lands also reach Minnesota, Iowa, Missouri and Illinois

facts.text: The Nation dates reclaiming the name Ho-Chunk to 1994, when it adopted its present constitution.
facts.evidence: the nation reclaimed their original name: Ho-Chunk

facts.text: The Nation identifies a 1963 constitution as a basis of its constitutional government.
The Nation describes three legislative districts within Wisconsin and a fourth covering places outside the state.
facts.evidence: a fourth district being anything outside of Wisconsin
